description: This file contains implementation details for object name resolution and disambiguation in a Git repository context. It defines functions to obtain object IDs from various references, prefixes, and abbreviated names, handles ambiguity, and supports dereferencing objects like tags and commits. It also includes internal logic for parsing object specifications such as ^, ~, @{-N}, and special references used in Git operations.

classes.name: disambiguate_state
classes.description: Structure used internally to maintain state during object name disambiguation, including prefix length, candidate objects, repository context, and function pointers for disambiguation hints.

classes.name: ambiguous_output
classes.description: Structure used for formatting output of ambiguous objects, including the disambiguate state and buffers for advice and output string.

classes.name: grab_nth_branch_switch_cbdata
classes.description: Data structure passed to callback for fetching the Nth previous branch switch message.

methods.description: Main internal function that attempts to resolve an object ID from a string, handling various Git-specific syntax and ambiguity considerations.

methods.name: set_disambiguate_hint_config
methods.description: Sets the disambiguation hint function based on configuration string.

methods.name: int init_object_disambiguation(struct repository * r,const char * name,int len,const struct git_hash_algo * algo,struct disambiguate_state * ds)
methods.description: Initializes disambiguate_state structure with prefix info and repository context.

methods.name: int finish_object_disambiguation(struct disambiguate_state * ds,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Finalizes object ID resolution, handling ambiguity and returning the correct object ID.

methods.name: int repo_get_oid(struct repository * r,const char * name,struct object_id * oid)
